stream with fresh inputs. Each instance is a separate conversation: the next one
starts without this one's messages.

On every message you must choose exactly one action and put it as a JSON object
on the last line of your reply:

Grids are lists of rows; cells are integers 0-9; dimensions are 1-30.

Each demo request returns one more input-output pair of the task, up to the demo cap shown
with the input.

each demo request. An instance is over when a submission is correct or when the attempt
cap is reached, and one that ends unsolved costs the whole budget, 16, however
many submissions and demo requests it used. Feedback on a submission is only
correct/incorrect. There is no way to abandon an instance, and finish is refused until
the instance is over. Each instance is scored on its own, and lower cost is better.

def solve(inp):
    from collections import Counter
    cnt=Counter(v for r_ in inp for v in r_)
    bg=cnt.most_common(1)[0][0]
    pts=[(i,j) for i,r_ in enumerate(inp) for j,v in enumerate(r_) if v!=bg]
    rs=[p[0] for p in pts]; cs=[p[1] for p in pts]
    r0,r1,c0,c1=min(rs),max(rs),min(cs),max(cs)
    o=[r_[:] for r_ in inp]
    fill=(bg-1)%10
    for i in range(r0,r1+1):
        for j in range(c0,c1+1):
            if ((j==c0 or j==c1) or (i==r0 or i==r1)) and o[i][j]==bg:
                o[i][j]=fill
    return o
for k in ('Demo pair 1','Demo pair 2'):

import numpy as np, json
def solve(inp):
    a=np.array(inp); H,W=a.shape; out=a.copy()
    S={(i,j) for i in range(H) for j in range(W) if a[i,j]!=a[0,0]}
    while len(S)>=4:
        cands=[(r1,c1,r2,c2) for r1,c1 in S for r2,c2 in S if r1<r2 and c1<c2 and (r1,c2) in S and (r2,c1) in S]
        if not cands: break
        rec=max(cands,key=lambda rec:((rec[2]-rec[0]+1)*(rec[3]-rec[1]+1), -(sum((rec[0],rec[1]) in S)+(rec[0],rec[3]) in S)+(rec[2],rec[1]) in S+(rec[2],rec[3]) in S))
        rem={(rec[0],rec[1]),(rec[0],rec[3]),(rec[2],rec[1]),(rec[2],rec[3])}
        S-=rem
    for (r1,c1,r2,c2) in [x for x in [(0,0)]]: pass
    best=[]
    # redo: need to store rects; recompute with storage
    return None
# simpler: collect all maximal quartet rects in one pass (greedy largest), then fill borders.
def findQ(S):
    S=set(S); Q=[]
    while len(S)>=4:
        cands=[(r1,c1,r2,c2) for r1,c1 in S for r2,c2 in S if r1<r2 and c1<c2 and (r1,c2) in S and (r2,c1) in S]
        if not cands: break
        rec=max(cands,key=lambda rec:(-((rec[2]-rec[0]+1)*(rec[3]-rec[1]+1)), -sum(((rec[0],rec[1]),(rec[0],rec[3]),(rec[2],rec[1]),(rec[2],rec[3]))[k] in S for k in [0])))
        Q.append(rec)
        rem={(rec[0],rec[1]),(rec[0],rec[3]),(rec[2],rec[1]),(rec[2],rec[3])}
        S-=rem
    return Q
for k in range(1,7):
    di=G[f'Demo pair {k} input']; do_=G[f'Demo pair {k} output']
    d=np.array(di)
    S={(i,j) for i in range(d.shape[0]) for j in range(d.shape[1]) if d[i,j]!=d[0,0]}
    Q=findQ(S)
    print(k,len(Q),'corner markers left',len(S), 'changed cells',np.argwhere(np.array(do_)!=d).shape[0])
